hypothesis: For sweep→MSS→OB setups, MSS range expansion relative to the initiating sweep event may identify genuine displacement better than body magnitude or prior-bar comparison.

configs.C01: MSS full range > original sweep-bar full range
configs.C02: MSS full range > both previous-bar range and original sweep-bar range
configs.C03: MSS full range > maximum full range of all completed bars strictly between sweep and MSS
